summary.zh-CN: 长任务现在可以自动压缩上下文并继续执行，同时加入消息续跑、工作区文件引用和提供商模型发现。
summary.en-US: Long tasks can now compact context and continue automatically, with message continuation, workspace file references, and provider model discovery.

title.zh-CN: 长任务自动压缩上下文

body.zh-CN: Native Agent 会按完整模型预算压缩较早上下文，保留摘要与最近用户原文，并在同一次任务中继续执行。
body.en-US: Native Agents compact earlier context against the full model budget, preserve a summary and recent user messages, and continue within the same task.

body.zh-CN: 最近一条用户消息可以编辑后重跑，中断或失败的助手回复可以从原位置继续。
body.en-US: The latest user message can be edited and rerun, while interrupted or failed replies can continue in place.

body.zh-CN: 文件、目录和选中文本可以作为结构化引用发送，AI 能读取内容，用户也能返回源文件。
body.en-US: Files, folders, and selected text can be sent as structured references that the AI can read and users can reopen.

title.zh-CN: 模型目录与 Exa 搜索

body.zh-CN: Provider 设置支持发现和刷新聊天模型，搜索设置新增 Exa 提供商。
body.en-US: Provider settings can discover and refresh chat models, and Search settings now support Exa.

body.zh-CN: 会话草稿、Panel App 滚动位置和消息时间线在切换或刷新后保持稳定。
body.en-US: Conversation drafts, Panel App scroll position, and message timelines remain stable across navigation and reloads.

title.zh-CN: 统一的阅读与管理体验

body.zh-CN: 收件箱、通知、Agent 管理、定时任务和聊天界面更加一致，并新增炭夜深色主题。
body.en-US: Inbox, notifications, Agent management, cron jobs, and chat surfaces are more consistent, with a new Charcoal Night theme.

body.zh-CN: 压缩事件刷新后保持正确位置，继续运行和进程重启后的状态也会正确收敛。
body.en-US: Compaction events keep their timeline position after reload, and run state now converges correctly after continuation or process restart.

body.zh-CN: 修复全新安装模板、stdio 图片附件、重复聊天错误和部分消息顺序问题。
body.en-US: Fixes cover fresh-install templates, stdio image attachments, duplicate chat errors, and message ordering.

body.zh-CN: 已有配置保持不变；过小的 Agent 上下文窗口会在保存时明确拒绝。
body.en-US: Existing configuration is preserved; Agent context windows that are too small are rejected when saved.
